safe_content_feature_requests.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand combat interactions and movement mechanics immediately upon entering a route.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Without explicit intro text or tooltips during the first few steps, new players might wonder how actions map out.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add a brief narrative hint or welcome message at step 0 explaining how walking and enemy encounters work.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Log and Collector Milestones
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Provides a clear overview of undiscovered secrets, collectibles, and cosmetics across all routes.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: As an Explorer & Collector, having an in-game tracking mechanism for route discoveries heavily drives replayability and engagement.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: A menu section displaying collected items per route and rewarding completionists with unique cosmetic tints.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Add Elite Enemy Encounters to Difficulty 3+ Routes
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Provides high-risk, high-reward tactical choices for players seeking mastery and greater engagement.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Current encounters are too sparse and lack mechanical friction, failing to satisfy combat-focused playstyles.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Incorporate elite variants with distinct behavior profiles into higher-tier routes via content pack adjustments.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Coin Bundle Special for Route Completion
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Gives players a clearer path to saving up for high-value items like the Waypoint Crown without altering core drop rates.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: After buying two cosmetics, players are left with a low balance, stalling momentum toward the most expensive cosmetic tier.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a temporary marketplace special or route-incentive bonus to smooth out the coin threshold gap.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: High-Contrast UI Theme Option
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Improves readability for players with visual impairments or when playing in brightly lit environments.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Clear text and UI borders reduce cognitive load and accessibility barriers.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add an optional high-contrast mode toggle in the settings menu.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Explicit Input Buffering Feedback for Obstacles
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Clearer visual or textual feedback when movement inputs are rejected due to an active blocking hazard.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Helps edge-case testers distinguish between input lag and intended path blocking.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add explicit descriptive hints when invalid movement commands collide with static hazards.

observations.evidence: Successfully started on the 'moss' route and walked through to completion without getting lost or confused.
observations.recommendation: Keep the introductory Moss Trail straightforward as an onboarding baseline.

observations.evidence: Fought three distinct enemies (Goblin, Slime, Kobold) and maintained 100 HP throughout the entire 12-step session.
observations.recommendation: Ensure early combat scaling remains gentle for newcomers.

observations.evidence: Completed Whispering Fen route and earned +25 coins, noting collectibles Mooncap and Fen Pearl listed in world state.
observations.recommendation: Add a dedicated collection ledger in the UI so players can easily track which unique route collectibles (like Mooncap and Fen Pearl) they have acquired.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased and equipped Trail Cap for 45 coins, leaving 88 coins.
observations.recommendation: Expand the cosmetic lineup or rotate stock to give collectors more long-term cosmetic purchase goals.

observations.evidence: World state features the Moss Trail with a 'Moss Token Rumor' collectible rumor.
observations.recommendation: Incorporate brief environmental lore text pop-ups when discovering rumored items to enhance the exploration reward.

observations.evidence: Out of 12 steps on a difficulty 3 route ('Frostfang Pass'), only two enemies were encountered (Slime at step 2, Kobold at step 11), with long stretches of uninterrupted walking and jumping.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy density and introduce staggered threat types on higher difficulty routes to sustain combat pressure.

observations.evidence: Player started with a hidden baseline coin pool that allowed two rapid market purchases (Trail Cap and Moon Hood) right after completing a single route, but was left with 21 coins, unable to afford the highest-tier item (Waypoint Crown).
observations.recommendation: Examine early-game income curves relative to mid-tier item pricing to ensure players understand the pacing gap between standard cosmetics and premium crown items.

observations.evidence: Marketplace correctly blocked the player from purchasing the Waypoint Crown with the message 'Not enough coins.' when balance was 21 coins.
observations.recommendation: Keep the clear out-of-funds messaging and consider adding a wishlist or progress bar toward the next tier item.

observations.evidence: Market purchase feedback successfully registered item ownership and coin subtraction but lacked explicit visual focus states for keyboard/mouse navigation.
observations.recommendation: Ensure keyboard focus rings are high-contrast and clearly visible on all interactive marketplace items.

observations.evidence: Coin collection messages ('Found 6 coins', 'Found 12 coins') clearly informed the player of currency gains during movement actions.
observations.recommendation: Maintain distinct, readable text feedback for all resource acquisition events.

observations.evidence: Repeated walk actions against step 2 (telemetry shows obstacle_hit with 8 damage twice) before the player successfully performed a jump action.
observations.recommendation: Ensure state validation cleanly prevents redundant movement command queuing when an obstacle state flag is active.

bugs.title: Repeated Walk Input Into Obstacle Spams Damage
repro_steps: Walk forward to step 2 where an obstacle is present
Issue 'walk' command multiple times consecutively without jumping
bugs.expected: The player should hit the obstacle once, take damage once, and be blocked from passing until jumping.
bugs.observed: The telemetry records multiple consecutive 'obstacle_hit' events (damage: 8) for duplicate walk attempts at the same step before jumping.
